aloud.name: Read Aloud: Text to Speech
aloud.short: Listen to books, PDFs and articles offline. Sleep timer, widget.
aloud.full:
Read Aloud turns any text into speech right on your phone. Open a book, a PDF or an article and listen — with the screen off, in another app, on the bus or falling asleep. No internet needed: the voice of your phone reads everything offline.

OPEN ANYTHING

Books and documents: EPUB, FB2, PDF and TXT (Russian Windows-1251 text files too).
Paste any text, or Share an article from the browser, mail or a messenger — it is read at once.
Select text in any app → Read Aloud in the selection menu.

LISTEN THE WAY YOU READ

The phrase being read is highlighted and the page turns by itself.
Tap any phrase to read from there. Skip a phrase back or forward.
Speed from 0.5× to 3×. Every voice installed on your phone, in every language.
Remembers your place in every book — the home screen offers to go on from the same phrase.

READ IN THE BACKGROUND

Keeps reading with the screen locked or in another app. Pause from the notification or with your headphone buttons. A call pauses the reading.

FALL ASLEEP TO A BOOK

Sleep timer: 15 or 30 minutes, the end of the chapter, or your own time from 1 minute to 10 hours.

FINISHED? TAKE IT WITH YOU

At the end of a text the app offers «Save audio» right there: the whole text as an audio file (M4A) in Music — for the car, the player or a message to mom. Pass it on in one tap: to MP3 in Video to MP3, chapters joined in Merge Audio.

EVERY EVENING, ON ITS OWN

When the sleep timer goes off, one tap turns the same time into a schedule: every evening the book starts where you stopped and turns off on time.

FREE

All formats, background reading, sleep timer, your place, every voice. No minute limits, no ads, no account.

ALL INCLUDED

Listen in the car and send it — save a text or a chapter as an audio file.
Every evening, on its own — a reading schedule.
Listen over any app — a floating button over YouTube, a feed or a browser: play, pause, sleep timer.
Names and abbreviations said right — a pronunciation dictionary.
Also: home screen widget.
Listening itself stays free, with no minute limits. Want to say thanks? Leave a tip from the menu — it unlocks nothing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

The text is read by the speech engine of your phone. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload your files or text — they leave the phone only when you share them.

The app speaks 25 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, 日本語, Türkçe, Français, हिन्दी, Deutsch, 한국어, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, Italiano, Polski, বাংলা, اردو, 繁體中文, Nederlands, Bahasa Melayu, Українська, Oʻzbekcha, Čeština, Română.

clients.name: Client Database & Tracker
clients.short: Clients, contracts, deadlines and documents in one place. Offline, no account.
clients.full:
Clients is a client database for accountants, lawyers, tutors and anyone who works with regular clients. One card per client shows the whole picture at once: tax ID, contracts, terms, deadlines, documents and money. What is due comes first.

ALL CLIENTS ON ONE SCREEN

Each client is one card that grows with what you write in: avatar or logo, tax ID, contract type and number, sum and currency, the term "from — to" with a bar, or open-ended.
Three tiles on top: Due soon · Missing docs · Money. Tap a tile — the list is filtered.
Search by name, tax ID, contract number or phone.

YOUR WAY, ANY COUNTRY

You name the contract types yourself — service agreement, retainer, lease, anything. Any currency, or none.
Cards are built from blocks: text, number or code, date, deadline with a reminder, sum, percent, checklist, payment by month, contact.
Ready cards: company details, contract, documents for the period, contact, note, court case, lease, tax, my fee, liquidation, or your own card.
A comment for yourself on every client: what is where, whom to send it to.

DEADLINES THAT DO NOT SLIP

A deadline reminds you N days before. Repeats monthly, quarterly or yearly — mark it done and the next one is set.
A notification on the phone once a day, only when something is due.
Contract ends — extend it in one tap. Deadlines to your calendar (.ics).

DOCUMENTS FROM CLIENTS

A photo or a PDF in WhatsApp, Telegram or mail → Share → Clients → whose is it and which item it closes. The item is ticked by itself.
Documents of each client by month: open, send, remove, ZIP of the month.

REMIND IN ONE TAP

The reminder text is ready: what is due and what is still missing. Send it by WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS or e-mail. When everything is collected, the button says Write instead of Remind.

QUICK ACTIONS

Invoice, Sign, Letter: open our Invoice, Stamp & Sign and Email Maker apps with the client details already copied.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE

No account, no server, no ads. The app has no internet permission at all. Backup to a file, restore, export to Excel (CSV).

FREE

Up to 3 clients, all deadlines and reminders, remind and write, backup and export.

ALL INCLUDED

Unlimited clients, documents from clients, money (contracts per month and who has not paid you), tax, my fee and liquidation cards, import from Excel.

22 languages. Made by LOKIO.

compress-pdf.name: Compress PDF — Offline, No Ads
compress-pdf.short: Make a PDF smaller to the size you need. Text stays sharp. Offline, no ads.
compress-pdf.full:
Compress PDF makes a PDF smaller right on your phone — to the size you need. A form says "up to 2 MB" and the file weighs 14 MB? Pick the PDF, set the target, tap "Compress and send": it goes out already under your number. No ads, no account, no internet.

ONE BUTTON: COMPRESS AND SEND

"Compress and send" compresses the PDF to your target and opens Share straight away — mail, Telegram, WhatsApp, Drive. Copies stay in Downloads › Compress PDF with "_compressed" in the name. Originals are not touched.

TEXT STAYS TEXT

Only the pictures inside the PDF are recompressed: scans, photos, charts. Text, fonts and links stay as they are — sharp at any zoom, and you can still select and search them. A PDF that is almost all text has little to squeeze, and the app tells you so honestly.

THE RIGHT SIZE, NOT A GUESS

Before you tap, the app shows how small this file can get. Drag the slider or tap a common limit: 500 KB, 1, 2, 5, 10, 25 MB. For scans there is a "Readable" mark — the smallest size at which small print still reads.

SEE THE PAGES

Every page large with a magnifier: pinch to zoom, swipe to the next page.

NO LIMITS

One PDF at a time to any size. "Readable" mark for scans. Share all results at once. Open a PDF from Files, mail or Telegram with "Open with" or "Share". Light and dark theme, 22 languages. No watermark.

ALL INCLUDED

• Photos into one PDF under the limit — the form wants "one PDF up to 2 MB" and you have photos of a passport or a certificate? Pick them, tap once: one PDF of exactly that size.
• Many PDFs at once — one target for the whole stack, or each file to its own size.
• Scan in black & white — scanned pages become crisp black and white: several times lighter, small text stays sharp.
• Only the pages you need — tick pages on a grid, the rest stay out of the copy. Also included: send everything as one ZIP (even a single file), a password for the compressed copy, several PDFs joined into one under the limit, and a file that will not fit split into parts that do.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

PDFs are processed on the phone. The app has no internet permission, so nothing can be uploaded anywhere — check it yourself in Android settings.

compress-video.name: Compress Video: Size Reducer
compress-video.short: Make videos smaller for chats and email. See the size first. Works offline.
compress-video.full:
Compress Video makes your videos smaller — right on your phone, without internet. Pick a video, see the size before you start, done. Your videos never leave the phone.

SEE THE SIZE FIRST

Each quality shows the size and resolution you'll get before anything starts: High looks like the original, Normal is right for chats and mail, Small is 720p and the lightest.

STILL TOO BIG FOR WHATSAPP? FIXED ON THE SPOT

WhatsApp takes 16 MB, Discord 10 MB, mail 25 MB. If the compressed video is still bigger, the app offers «Make it 16 MB» right on the Done screen: the same video, exactly under the limit.

NEVER BIGGER THAN THE ORIGINAL

If a video is already compact and can't get smaller without losing quality, the app tells you so and saves nothing.

FAST, ON YOUR PHONE

The phone's own video encoder does the work, so a long video doesn't take half an hour. HDR videos from new phones become regular ones that play everywhere.

PLAYS EVERYWHERE

The result is an MP4 that plays in messengers, mail, the gallery and on any phone. Ready videos go to Movies / Compress Video with a clear name. Share them in one tap — or pass them on: the sound in Video to MP3, a trim in Video Cutter, speech to text in To Text.

ALL INCLUDED

Fits WhatsApp, mail and Discord — 10, 16, 25, 50 MB or your own. A frame for Reels, TikTok and Shorts — 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5. Only the part you need — start and end to a tenth of a second. Many videos at once, all of them in one archive.
Also: remove the sound track. No limits.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Everything happens on the phone itself. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload your videos. No account, no tracking.

The app speaks 22 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, 日本語, Türkçe, Français, हिन्दी, Deutsch, 한국어, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, Italiano, Polski, বাংলা, اردو, 繁體中文, Nederlands, Bahasa Melayu, Українська.

exif.name: Remove EXIF & GPS from Photos
exif.short: See which photos reveal where you were and send them clean. No internet.
exif.full:
Every photo carries hidden data: where it was taken, when, on which phone, often the camera's serial number. Anyone you send it to can read it. EXIF Cleaner shows which of your photos give that away and sends them clean in one tap.

SEE WHAT YOUR PHOTOS GIVE AWAY

All your photos in one grid. Photos that reveal a location are marked with a pin.
"What's inside" shows exactly what is written in a photo: location, date, camera, lens, serial number, author, and even the date hidden in the file name.

CLEAN AND SEND IN ONE TAP

Select every photo that reveals a location in one tap, or pick your own.
"Clean and send": location, date, camera, serial numbers and author are removed, and clean copies go straight to the chat. Share them all at once.
What to remove is in Settings — everything is ticked by default.
Take a photo and send it clean: the original with the location never reaches your Gallery.
Photos from Telegram, Files or mail open here via "Share" or "Open with".
Cancel a long batch at any moment: the photos already cleaned stay.

NO DUPLICATES, ORIGINALS UNTOUCHED

Originals are never changed. Sent copies do not pile up in your Gallery: they go to Pictures / EXIF Cleaner only when you choose to save them.
JPG, PNG and WebP are cleaned without re-compression: every pixel stays the same.
HEIC photos from iPhone are saved as clean JPG.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

The app has no internet permission at all. No account, no server, no analytics. Your photos physically cannot leave the phone.

ALL INCLUDED

Hide faces and the archive work once for free — you see the real result on your own photos before you pay.
• Hide faces: faces looking at the camera are blurred on the phone, and you see the result before sending.
• The whole batch as one ZIP: one file for mail, clients, Telegram.
• Clean file names: photo_01.jpg instead of a name that gives away the date.

22 languages, light and dark theme.

jpgpdf.name: JPG to PDF: Image to PDF Maker
jpgpdf.short: Photos to one clean PDF: A4 or Letter, margins, any order. Works offline.
jpgpdf.full:
JPG to PDF turns your photos into one clean PDF — right on your phone, without internet. Pick photos, set the order, choose the page, done. Your photos never leave the phone.

PHOTOS TO ONE PDF

Pick photos in the gallery or Share them here from the gallery, files or a messenger — JPG, PNG, WEBP and HEIC. Every photo becomes a page. Drag to set the order, remove a photo, add more. Tap a photo to see it large.

A4, LETTER OR AS THE PHOTO

Choose the page: A4, Letter or the exact size of the photo. Keep the whole photo with white margins, or fill the page. Margins, orientation, quality — the live preview shows the result before you save. Landscape photos get a landscape page automatically. Or 2 or 4 photos per page: an ID card front and back on one page, receipts for an expense report.

SHARP OR LIGHT

High quality keeps small text readable for print. Standard makes a lighter file for messengers and mail.

TOO HEAVY FOR A FORM? FIXED ON THE SPOT

Portals and application forms often take files only up to 2 MB. If your PDF is heavier, the Done screen offers «Shrink to 2 MB» — or 200 KB, 500 KB, 1 MB: the same photos are rebuilt under the limit, ready to upload.

READY IN DOWNLOADS

The PDF goes to Downloads / JPG to PDF with a clear name. Share it, open it, print it — or pass it on in one tap: add a stamp or signature, send it by email, merge it with other PDFs.

ALL INCLUDED

A file size limit — 200 KB, 500 KB, 1, 2 or 5 MB, or your own number exactly as the portal asks — for forms, portals and mail that won't take big files. Each photo as its own PDF, in one tap. A PDF locked with a password. Ready PDFs between your photos. Photos to PDF stays free, with no limits.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Everything happens on the phone itself. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload your photos. No account, no tracking.

The app speaks 22 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, 日本語, Türkçe, Français, हिन्दी, Deutsch, 한국어, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, Italiano, Polski, বাংলা, اردو, 繁體中文, Nederlands, Bahasa Melayu, Українська.

mail.name: Email Maker & HTML Signature
mail.short: Branded emails and HTML signatures for Gmail, right from your phone. Offline
mail.full:
Email Maker turns your phone into a small email studio. Set up your brand once — company, name, color, logo letters and contacts — and every email you write comes out branded: a colored header, clean text, a button with your link, a price box and a signature. Send it from your own Gmail or any mail app. No account, no ads, and no internet permission at all.

WHAT IT DOES

Templates: Letter, Letterhead, Offer with a price box, and Announcement with a big headline. Switch any time — what you wrote stays.
An HTML signature for Gmail on the phone: copy it once and paste it at the end of any email.
Mailing list in Bcc: paste addresses or load a list from Excel or CSV — or open the table with Email Maker straight from your files. Duplicates and broken addresses are removed, recipients never see each other.
A counter keeps you under the 500-a-day limit of a personal Gmail account.
Tips before sending: missing subject, a button without a link, CAPS, too many recipients, attachments over 25 MB — the usual reasons emails land in spam.
Attach PDFs and photos, or share files to the app from any other app.
Light and dark preview, so you see how the email looks in dark mode before it goes out.
Save any email as your own template and start the next one in one tap. An example brand and email help you start in seconds.

HOW SENDING WORKS

Tap Copy and open mail. Your mail app opens with the recipients, subject and attachments already filled in. Long-press the message field, tap Paste, send. The email goes from your own address, so replies come straight back to you.

FREE

No limits on emails.
One brand with an HTML signature.
The Letter template. The Letterhead template — free when you add your Lokio page.
Mailing lists in Bcc, Excel and CSV import, the daily counter, tips before sending.
Attachments, your own templates, light and dark preview, 22 languages.
No ads. No account. No "sent from" line.

ALL INCLUDED

• Email with AI in a minute — one request to any AI app you use, paste the answer: subject, text, price and button are filled in.
• Offer with a price and announcement — the Offer and Announcement templates and the email builder: add, remove and drag blocks.
• Attachments under the mail limit — heavy photos and PDFs shrink by themselves so the email fits into 25 MB. No other app needed.
• Several brands and mailing groups — a brand with its own signature for each business, saved client lists.
Also included: all colors, your own color from a palette, HEX or an image, a classic serif font, attachments as one archive.

WHO IT IS FOR

A café sending a wholesale offer to thirty clients. A tutor sending a price list. A job seeker sending a resume with a proper cover email. A small shop announcing a sale.

Privacy: your brand, emails and lists live only in the app on your phone. The app never sends anything itself — your mail app does, from your account.

merge.name: Merge PDF: Combine & Split
merge.short: Merge PDFs and photos into one file, split by pages. Offline, free, no limits.
merge.full:
Merge PDF joins PDFs and photos into one file and splits a PDF into parts — right on your phone. No internet needed: everything happens on the phone.

MERGE PDFs AND PHOTOS

Pick several PDFs and photos, or Share them here from Files, mail or a messenger. Each file shows its first page, name and page count. Hold ≡ and drag to set the order, ✕ removes a file, Add files brings more. Every photo becomes a page. One tap — one PDF. Each file gets its own bookmark, so the merged PDF opens with a table of contents. Turn on «All pages A4» and photos and pages of any size fit neatly on A4.

SPLIT A PDF

Every page as its own file. Chosen pages as one new PDF — tap the pages you need. Or ranges like 1-3, 5, 8-10 — each range becomes its own file. You see every page before you split.

READY FILES

Files are saved to Downloads / Merge PDF with clear names: report_merged.pdf, report_p3.pdf, report_1-3.pdf. Share them, open them in your PDF viewer or print them. Next steps in one tap: make the file smaller, add a stamp or signature, pull out the text.

TOO HEAVY FOR EMAIL? SPLIT ON THE SPOT

Email takes attachments up to 20–25 MB, upload portals often up to 10. If your merged PDF is heavier, the Done screen offers «Split into parts up to 10 MB» — or 2, 5, 25 MB: the same file in parts, ready to send.

FREE, ALWAYS

Merge and split with no limits on files or pages. No account, no watermark, no sign-up.

ALL INCLUDED

• Only the pages you need — take 1-3, 5 from one file and everything from another, in one merge.
• Parts of the right size — split a PDF into files up to 2, 5, 10 or 25 MB, so it fits an upload portal or an email. Every part shows its size.
• Page tools — rotate, remove and reorder pages in one PDF.
• Passwords — open password-protected PDFs and lock your own.
• Page numbers and a watermark across every page.
Also included: split every N pages, and send all parts as one ZIP.
Want to say thanks? Leave a tip from the menu — you choose the amount. It unlocks nothing and helps make the next apps.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your files are processed on the phone itself. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload your documents — they leave the phone only when you share them.

The app speaks 22 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, 日本語, Türkçe, Français, हिन्दी, Deutsch, 한국어, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, Italiano, Polski, বাংলা, اردو, 繁體中文, Nederlands, Bahasa Melayu, Українська.

merge-audio.name: Merge Audio: MP3 Joiner
merge-audio.short: Join songs and voice notes into one MP3 with no gaps. Crossfade. Offline.
merge-audio.full:
Merge Audio joins songs and voice notes into one MP3 — right on your phone, without internet. No gaps between files. No watermark. Your files never leave the phone.

ANY FILES TOGETHER

MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG and voice notes — different formats and quality go into one file. Add as many as you like.

HEAR THE JOINS BEFORE YOU SAVE

The player shows the wave around the playhead and every join with the name of the next file. Drag the wave to rewind, jump to the next or previous join, tap a file to play from its start. Drag ≡ to change the order.

TOO BIG FOR WHATSAPP? FIXED ON THE SPOT

Twenty voice notes or a lecture in parts easily pass 16 MB, while WhatsApp takes 16 MB and mail 25 MB. The app sees it and offers «Make it 16 MB» right on the Done screen: the same join, a smaller file.

WORKS IN THE BACKGROUND

Joining hundreds of files? Leave the app — the progress stays in the notification, with Cancel.

NO LIMITS

Join any number of songs and voice notes back to back, MP3 192 kbps, with the player. Ready files go to Music / Merge Audio. Next in one tap: cut a ringtone in MP3 Cutter or turn speech into text in To Text.

ALL INCLUDED

Crossfade 1–10 s — each song fades into the next, like a DJ mix. Same loudness — quiet voice notes and loud songs sound equally loud. Fits WhatsApp and mail — 16 or 25 MB, the quality is picked for you. Pause 0.5–5 s between files — for lessons and audiobooks.
Also: the sound of videos, quality 128 or 320 kbps, no daily limit.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Everything happens on the phone itself. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload your files. No account, no tracking.

merge-video.name: Merge Video: Video Joiner
merge-video.short: Join videos & photos into one MP4 for Reels, TikTok, Shorts. No watermark.
merge-video.full:
Merge Video joins your videos into one MP4 — right on your phone, without internet. Vertical and horizontal clips go into one frame without stretching. No watermark. Your videos never leave the phone.

ANY VIDEOS TOGETHER

Pick as many videos as you like from the gallery at once — vertical, horizontal, from the camera or a messenger, with or without sound. The frame follows the first video; the others fit inside it whole, with bars, never stretched.

WATCH IT BEFORE YOU SAVE

The player on top plays the whole merge in a row, exactly as it will be saved: every clip, every trim, the bars or the filled frame. Skip between clips with one tap. Drag ≡ to change the order, × removes a clip.

REELS, TIKTOK AND SHORTS

Make it 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9 and fill the frame — no bars, the edges are trimmed around the center.

PHOTOS AND VIDEOS IN ONE CLIP

Put photos from the gallery between your videos — a trip, a birthday, a photo dump for Reels and TikTok. Each photo stays on screen 2, 3, 5 or 8 seconds.

STICKERS, TEXT AND YOUR LOGO

Add a caption, your logo, a GIF or a drawing on top of the whole video. Drag it, resize and rotate it with one finger, set the opacity for a watermark. The player shows it exactly as it will be saved.

TRIM EACH CLIP

Cut the start and the end of every clip right on the screen: a strip of frames with handles, zoom for a precise cut, steps of 0.1 s. The player shows the exact frame under your finger.

FITS DISCORD AND MAIL

Pick 8, 10, 25 or 50 MB or type your own — the video comes out under the limit.

WORKS IN THE BACKGROUND

Merging a long video? Leave the app — the progress stays in the notification, with Cancel.

NO LIMITS

Merge videos into one MP4 in the frame of the first video, with the player and the order. Ready files go to Movies / Merge Video.

ALL INCLUDED

Photos between videos · stickers, text, logo and GIF · frame 9:16 · 1:1 · 4:5 · 16:9 with fill · trim each clip · fit a size.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Everything happens on the phone itself. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload your videos. No account, no tracking.

The app speaks 22 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, 日本語, Türkçe, Français, हिन्दी, Deutsch, 한국어, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, Italiano, Polski, বাংলা, اردو, 繁體中文, Nederlands, Bahasa Melayu, Українська.

mp3-cutter.name: MP3 Cutter & Ringtone Maker
mp3-cutter.short: Cut any song exactly on the wave and make it your ringtone. Works offline.
mp3-cutter.full:
MP3 Cutter cuts any song or voice note exactly where you want — right on your phone, without internet — and sets it as your ringtone in one tap. Your files never leave the phone.

CUT ON THE WAVE

See the whole track as a wave. Drag two handles, fine-tune with ±0.1 s, and listen to the part before you save it.

RINGTONE IN ONE TAP

Set the cut as your ringtone, notification sound or alarm right from the Done screen. Android asks once for «Modify system settings» — that is all it is used for.

NO RINGTONE THAT BURSTS IN

Cut from the middle of a song? The app sees it and offers «Make it soft» right on the Done screen: the sound fades in and out over 2 seconds. A quiet recording gets «Make it louder».

SONGS AND VOICE NOTES

MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG and voice notes all work. Ready files go to Music / MP3 Cutter with a clear name. Listen right in the app, share in one tap — or join it with other tracks in Merge Audio.

ALL INCLUDED

A soft ringtone — fades in and out, the call doesn’t burst in. Cut out the middle — remove an ad, a pause or a mistake and keep both ends. Louder — 150% or 200% for quiet tracks, peaks softened. Sound from a video — a piece of a clip or a Reels as a ringtone or MP3.
Also: quality 128 or 320 kbps. No limits.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Everything happens on the phone itself. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload your files. No account, no tracking.

The app speaks 22 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, 日本語, Türkçe, Français, हिन्दी, Deutsch, 한국어, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, Italiano, Polski, বাংলা, اردو, 繁體中文, Nederlands, Bahasa Melayu, Українська.

pdf-text.name: PDF to Text — Offline, No Ads
pdf-text.short: Clean text from any PDF, even scans. TXT or Markdown for AI. Offline, no ads.
pdf-text.full:
PDF to Text turns any PDF into clean text right on your phone. A 240-page book becomes about 500 KB of text you can paste into any AI chat, a note or a message. Pick a file, tap one button, done. No ads, no account, no internet.

CLEAN TEXT, NOT A MESS

Lines inside a paragraph are joined, words split at line ends are put back together, running headers and page numbers are removed, and spaced-out letters in titles are fixed. Tables come out as tables. Works with big files: a 200 MB book is read page by page, with progress and a Cancel button.

TXT OR MARKDOWN

TXT is plain text for reading and notes. Markdown keeps headings, lists and tables and adds invisible page marks, so an AI can tell you which page it found something on.

ONE TAP TO SEND

"Get text and send" opens Share right away — a chat, mail, Drive. Or copy all the text and paste it anywhere. Every result also goes to Downloads › PDF to Text. Your PDF is never changed.

NO LIMITS

One PDF at a time, any size.
TXT and Markdown.
Copy, share, save.
See every page large before you start.
No watermark. Light and dark theme. 22 languages.

ALL INCLUDED

• Scan to text — a scan is only pictures of pages. The app recognizes them right on the phone, offline: 12 scripts, from Latin and Cyrillic to Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic and Hindi.
• Many PDFs at once — a whole stack in one tap.
• Only the pages you need — tick pages on a grid with a magnifier, and the text comes only from them.
• Parts for AI — a whole book won't fit into an AI chat in one paste. The app cuts it into parts of the size you choose, each copied in one tap and marked [1/6], [2/6]… Also included: several PDFs as one text file, and all results in one ZIP.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

PDFs are processed on the phone, scans too. The app has no internet permission, so nothing can be uploaded anywhere — check it yourself in Android settings.

pdfjpg.name: PDF to JPG: Image Converter
pdfjpg.short: PDF pages to sharp JPG pictures in your gallery. Offline, every page, free.
pdfjpg.full:
PDF to JPG turns the pages of any PDF into sharp pictures right on your phone — and puts them straight into your gallery. No internet needed: everything happens on the phone.

PDF → PICTURES IN A SECOND

Choose a PDF or Share it here from Files, mail or a messenger. Every page shows up at once. All pages are selected — tap a page to leave it out, tap again to bring it back.

SEE EVERY PAGE BEFORE YOU SAVE

Tap the magnifier on a page to see it full screen. Tap to zoom in, swipe to the next page, select or leave it out right there.

SHARP TEXT

High quality — 300 DPI: small text stays readable when you zoom in. Standard — 150 DPI, lighter for messengers.

STRAIGHT TO YOUR GALLERY

Pictures are saved to Gallery / PDF to JPG, in order, with clear names: report_p1.jpg, report_p2.jpg… Share them all at once, open them, or pass them on in one tap: make the photos smaller, crop them to a format, send them by email.

TOO HEAVY FOR A PORTAL? FIXED ON THE SPOT

QUIET RECORDING? LOUDER IN ONE TAP

A concert from the back row or a lecture from the last desk — the app notices and makes it twice as loud, with peaks softened so nothing crackles.

HONEST ABOUT SILENCE

If a video has no sound track, the app tells you right away instead of making an empty file.

READY TO SEND

Ready files go to Music / Video to MP3 with a clear name. Listen right in the app, share in one tap — or pass it on: cut a ringtone in MP3 Cutter, join tracks in Merge Audio, turn speech into text in To Text.

ALL INCLUDED

Only the part you need — just the chorus or the speech, to a tenth of a second. Fits WhatsApp and mail — 16 or 25 MB, the quality is picked for you. Louder — 150% or 200%. Many at once, all in one archive.
Also: voice notes and audio files → MP3, M4A without re-encoding, 128 or 320 kbps.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Everything happens on the phone itself. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload your files. No account, no tracking.

The app speaks 22 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, 日本語, Türkçe, Français, हिन्दी, Deutsch, 한국어, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, Italiano, Polski, বাংলা, اردو, 繁體中文, Nederlands, Bahasa Melayu, Українська.

voice.name: Video & Audio to Text, Offline
voice.short: Speech to text on your phone: lectures, meetings, videos. Works offline.
voice.full:
To Text turns speech into text right on your phone. Record a lecture, a meeting, a talk with friends or a walk in the mountains — the text appears while you record, and after Stop it is ready to copy or send to your AI. No internet needed: everything runs on the phone.

TWO SOURCES

Sound around you — a lecture hall, a meeting room, your own voice. Tap and recording starts.
Sound on your phone — any video or audio that plays on it: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Telegram, webinars, the browser. Absolutely any source, except apps that forbid recording their sound. Nothing to download, no links to paste: what plays is what gets recorded.

ONLY WHAT YOU NEED

Pause where it gets boring, skip ahead, resume — only the parts you need go into the text. Silence is not recorded.

THE TEXT

Text appears while you record, phrase by phrase with time stamps.
Copy it, or send it To AI in one tap for a summary and tasks.
Save as TXT or MD, or share. Tap a phrase — the sound plays from that spot.
Listen to the text read aloud in Read Aloud.
Speech in 22 languages, detected by itself: English, Español, Português, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Русский, Українська, Polski, Türkçe, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Nederlands, Română, Čeština, العربية, اردو, 日本語, 한국어, 中文, Tiếng Việt, ไทย.
Files work too: choose audio or video, Share a voice message from a messenger, or open a recording with To Text straight from your files.

FREE

Recording from the microphone and from the phone without limits, files, every feature for the text. No ads, no account.

ALL INCLUDED

• Long recordings in full: lectures, meetings, webinars and podcasts longer than 30 minutes get the whole text, not just the start.
• Floating button over any app: ▶ record, tap to pause, ■ stop — the text is made by itself while you watch the next video.
• Translation to English on the phone: a lecture in another language becomes English text.
• SRT subtitles: a subtitle file with time codes for your own video — CapCut, YouTube, Premiere.
• To Word: the text as a .docx file with paragraphs, ready to edit in Word or Google Docs.

Want to say thanks? Leave a tip from the menu — you choose the amount. It unlocks nothing and keeps the next apps free of ads.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Speech recognition runs on the phone. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload your recordings or text — they leave the phone only when you share them. Recordings take about 30 MB per hour of sound.

The app speaks 25 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, 日本語, Türkçe, Français, हिन्दी, Deutsch, 한국어, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, Italiano, Polski, বাংলা, اردو, 繁體中文, Nederlands, Bahasa Melayu, Українська, Oʻzbekcha, Čeština, Română.

zip-extractor.name: Zip Extractor: Unzip, RAR, 7z
zip-extractor.short: Open ZIP, RAR, 7z from Telegram. Shrink photos into 25 MB for email.
zip-extractor.full:
Zip Extractor opens ZIP, RAR and 7z archives right on your phone — from Telegram, WhatsApp, mail or Files. Photos inside show up as tiles, every file opens with one tap, and "Save all" puts everything into Downloads. Opening, packing and saving archives has no limits. No ads, no account, no internet.

ANY ARCHIVE

ZIP, RAR (including RAR5), 7z, TAR, GZ, BZ2, XZ, ISO and CAB. Archives in parts — part1.rar, .001 — open when you pick all parts at once. Password archives open too, even when the file names are hidden. The password is never stored.

SEE WHAT'S INSIDE

Photos and videos inside the archive show as tiles with previews, iPhone HEIC photos included. Documents show as a list with their folders and sizes, in the same order as in Files. Tap any file — it opens without unpacking the whole archive.

SAVE IN ONE TAP

"Save all" puts the files into Downloads › Zip Extractor, with the folders exactly as in the archive. Need only some? Tick them — or "Select all" — and save or send just those. Big archives keep unpacking in the background, with progress and Cancel in the notification. No limits.

PACK AND SEND

Photos and files in one ZIP or 7z, with a password if you like — and the share sheet opens right away. ZIP opens anywhere; 7z with a password uses AES-256 and hides the file names too.

ALL INCLUDED

ZIP barely shrinks photos, videos and PDFs: 40 photos are still 140 MB, and email takes 25 MB. The app shrinks them while packing — just enough to fit: 25 MB for email, 10 MB or 5 MB for portals. One tap: "Shrink and send". Your originals stay untouched.
• Too big even shrunk — several archives, each opens on its own.
• Shrink an archive you received and forward it. RAR and 7z become ZIP that opens on iPhone and Windows.
• iPhone photos (HEIC) go to your Gallery and into archives as JPG.
• Save files out without the daily limit.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Everything happens on the phone itself. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot upload your files. No account, no tracking, no ads.

The app speaks 22 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية, 日本語, Türkçe, Français, हिन्दी, Deutsch, 한국어, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, Italiano, Polski, বাংলা, اردو, 繁體中文, Nederlands, Bahasa Melayu, Українська.
